name: orca-dev-ops
description: Orca-managed worktree workflow, coordination rules, and repository initialization for Codex, provided as skills. The orca-init skill installs the launch gate into each repository; the Codex sandbox flags and the repository's AGENTS.md remain the other guardrails.

interface.longDescription: Guides Codex through Orca worktree planning, task control, review, and delivery. Use $orca-init, or select orca-init through /skills, to initialize a repository. The initialization skill shares its procedure with Claude Code's /orca-init command and runs scripts/orca-init.sh from the loaded plugin's actual location. It installs worktree rules, the launch gate in .codex/hooks.json, and missing default repository settings.
